title: Request a proposal, review or assessment | Aquemi
meta: Choose a sizing proposal, route assessment, URS, feedwater or C&Q review, or an existing system assessment. An engineer replies in [response time].
headline: Tell us what you need sized, reviewed or assessed. An engineer answers in writing.
lead: Choose your request: a sizing proposal, a route assessment, a review of your user requirement specification (URS), feed water or commissioning and qualification (C&Q) plan, an existing system assessment or a compliance matrix. The form asks only what that request needs. Peak demand in L/h and the pharmacopoeia you release against (USP, Ph. Eur.) size most systems. Nothing here commits you to a purchase.

secondary_cta.label: System down or out of specification? Request service

blocks.h: Choose your request, then send what you have
blocks.intro: Came from another page with a named offer, such as a still sizing proposal or a C&Q plan review? The table under this form lists every request by the name that page uses and the option to choose. Rough numbers are fine. Files can follow by reply email.
blocks.submit: Send my request to an engineer
blocks.note: A process engineer replies within [proposal response time, working days]. Your specifications stay confidential [confidentiality terms, e.g. NDA on request]. We use your details to answer this request only and do not add you to a mailing list. [Privacy notice link; PIPEDA, Quebec Law 25]

blocks.note: If we are not the right supplier for your request, we say so in the first reply.

items.q: We do not have a URS yet. Is it too early?
items.a: No. Choose a water scope review or a route assessment. We return the grades, systems and qualification scope your URS should state, and you write it on that basis.

items.q: Does a review commit us to buying from you?
items.a: No. A review or assessment is a written answer you keep. [Confirm: reviews carry no obligation and may be used in the client's own tender.]

items.q: Our system was built by another supplier. Which form do we use?
items.a: This one: choose "Assessment of an existing system, any make". The service request form is for installed Aquemi systems with a serial number.

items.q: We are a consulting or EPCM engineer writing a specification for a client. Can we ask?
items.a: Yes. Choose the document review or the route assessment and say who the end user is, if you can. We answer the specification question and do not contact your client.

items.q: We have a tender package with our own forms. Can you bid to it?
items.a: Upload the package and the closing date and choose "Sizing and budget proposal for a new system". We reply within [proposal response time, working days] to confirm whether we will bid, with any clarification questions, before the deadline.

items.q: Can you give a budget figure before a call?
items.a: For a PW skid with a known peak demand and feed water analysis, [confirm whether budget ranges are given in the first reply]. WFI, pure steam and loops need the scoping call first, because utilities and points of use drive the price.

items.q: Will you sign our NDA before we share drawings?
items.a: Yes. Choose "Send our NDA first, then talk" in step 3, or attach your NDA. We return it signed within [NDA turnaround, working days].

items.q: Is our site outside your service area?
items.a: Ask anyway. Design, fabrication and the factory acceptance test (FAT) happen at our shop; installation and service coverage are on the locations page. [Confirm regions served outside Canada.]

cta.body: Call [sales phone number], [hours and time zone], and ask for a process engineer. Or choose "Not sure yet: talk to an engineer" in the form and we call you back.
